Intelligence reach enables the retrieval of existing information, intelligence products, and data that can support answering intelligence requirements in a timely manner without waiting for an answer to a request for information or an information collection task. The information, intelligence products, or data retrieved can then be evaluated for use in the unit’s intelligence products or analysis. nal, commercial, foreign, and university research programs. • Know the types of information that intelligence reach resources can provide. Continuously expand the resource directory by identifying new resources. • Use intelligence reach first to fill intelligence gaps and requirements and to answer requests for information. This technique can preclude unnecessary tasking or risk to limited collection assets. • Strive to maintain continuous situational understanding and anticipate intelligence requirements.
